title: Pseudo-letter cipher letter, 1728, with contemporary worksheets (BL Add MS 32287 ff. 37-40, DECODE R7707)

steps.what: Fetched the 8 DECODE images with the project cookie.
Transcribed f. 37r, 205 signs in 10 lines, with own labels; checked against the codebreaker's tally on f. 40r.
Read the worksheets ff. 38-40: tallies, contact tables, 'l = vowel e' guess; docket dated 4 Aout 1728. No decipherment.
IoC 1.07, no repeated trigrams; periodic IoC weak peaks at 5, 10, 15.
Monoalphabetic annealing (capped and injective) in en, fr, de, nl, it, es and la.
Vigenere, Beaufort and variant at periods 5 and 10, with the f. 40 tally order as the alphabet.
Quagmire-type anneal (unknown sign alphabet + periodic shifts), periods 5 and 10, fr and en.

outcome.method_basis: 205 signs with a flat index of coincidence; substitution, Vigenere and Quagmire-type annealing in seven languages failed and no key or clear copy is on DECODE.
outcome.fraction_read_source: no reading file; 0 of 205 cipher tokens
outcome.notes: Too short for a ciphertext-only break of a polyalphabetic system; needs the key or the other letters on the docket (31 Aout, 5 8bre).

prior.where: none found; the contemporary worksheets did not reach a reading

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
